title: 第十三章  二人伏首莞娘遇险第十四章  夫妻和鸣恶人登门
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 阳光被乌云遮掩，唯有丝丝缕缕从缝隙中透出。
三里镇小道。
陆川看着两具死不瞑目的尸体，没有半分迟疑，径直将他们逐一拖进林中。
虽然这条小道平日里来往的行人不多，但陆川还是开始迅速清理现场。
这两具尸体若是被人看见，陆川会惹上大麻烦。
直到将两具尸体拖进林间深处，又将路上的血迹尽可能地掩盖，他这才松了口气。
看着马鸣、贺晖的尸体，陆川心中不但没有半分恐惧，反而升起的是快意。
“看来，在武道未成前，都还是肉体凡胎，甚至未经修炼的普通人也有机会杀死。”
陆川自言自语。
这一次出手，陆川是经过深思熟虑的。
马鸣等人不过是武馆之中最为寻常的弟子，初涉武道，自身还未超越普通人太多。
而陆川由于箭术小成，双臂能拉开三石弓，意味着他起码能举起两百斤以上的重物。
再加上力量、速度属性加持，陆川的身体素质更是暴涨。
这也就是为什么他明知有诈，还敢单刀赴会的原因。
陆川看着两人的尸体，心念一动，俯下身开始在他们的身上摸索起来。
片刻后，陆川看着掌心那几两的碎银，面露失望。
他没有在马鸣等人身上找到任何关于武学的东西。
想来也是，若是武馆的一名寻常弟子也能随身带着珍贵的功法武学，
那这功法武学也太不值钱了。
虽然没有得到想要的，但解决了一个后患，他也算是不枉此行。
陆川将两具尸体掩埋，确定没有纰漏，这才慢悠悠离开。
虽然他不知道这两人的死能瞒多久，但两名普通弟子的死，那沧海武馆最多为了安抚人心，折腾几天。
等风头过去，这两人也就死得不明不白了。
眼下，只有一个人还没有处理。
陆川眼中寒芒一闪，
“我给你一个机会...希望你不要让我失望。”
“莞娘，我们一起回去吧。”
同村的巧儿，笑着对身旁的叶莞君说道。
叶莞君点了点头，
“好，巧儿，我们早点回去，也安全一点。”
三里镇离河西县足有十里，以她们的脚程，少说得一个时辰。
如今这世道，别说晚上，就算是光天白日也有贼人出没。
“莞娘，你要走了？”
同席的一个身穿长袍、束发戴冠的男人连忙站起身来。
“柴公子，天黑路滑，现在事情忙完了，我也该回去了。”
叶莞君不动声色看向男人。
这个男人名叫柴宗翰，正是摆席这户人家的小少爷。
柴宗翰脸上露出不舍，目光不留痕迹扫过叶莞君胸前，眼中隐隐透出贪婪。
content_en:
The sun was obscured by dark clouds, and only wisps of sunlight shone through the gaps.
Sanli Town Trail.
Lu Chuan looked at the two dead bodies and without any hesitation, he dragged them one by one into the forest.
Although there were not many pedestrians on this trail on weekdays, Lu Chuan still started to clean up the scene quickly.
If these two corpses were seen, Lu Chuan would get into big trouble.
It wasn't until he dragged the two bodies deep into the forest and covered up the bloodstains on the road as much as possible that he breathed a sigh of relief.
Looking at the bodies of Ma Ming and He Hui, Lu Chuan not only had no fear in his heart, but instead felt joy.
"It seems that before martial arts are achieved, they are still mortal bodies. Even ordinary people who have not practiced martial arts have the opportunity to kill."
Lu Chuan said to himself.
This time, Lu Chuan took action carefully.
Ma Ming and others are just the most ordinary disciples in the martial arts hall. They are new to martial arts and have not surpassed ordinary people by much.
As for Lu Chuan, due to his minor skills in archery, he could draw a three-stone bow with both arms, which meant that he could lift at least two hundred kilograms of weight.
Coupled with the blessing of strength and speed attributes, Lu Chuan's physical fitness has skyrocketed.
This is why he dared to go to the meeting alone even though he knew it was a scam.
Lu Chuan looked at the bodies of the two people, and with a thought in his mind, he leaned down and started groping on their bodies.
After a while, Lu Chuan looked at the few taels of broken silver in his palm with disappointment on his face.
He didn't find anything about martial arts in Ma Ming and others.
Thinking about it, if an ordinary disciple in a martial arts school can carry precious martial arts skills with him,
Then this Kung Fu and martial arts are too worthless.
Although he didn't get what he wanted, he solved a future problem and his trip was considered worthwhile.
Lu Chuan buried the two corpses and made sure there were no mistakes before leaving slowly.
Although he didn't know how long the deaths of these two people could be hidden, but the death of two ordinary disciples, the Canghai Martial Arts School would have to deal with it for a few days at most just to appease people's hearts.
When the limelight passed, these two people would die inexplicably.
Right now, there is only one person who has not been dealt with.
Lu Chuan's eyes flashed coldly,
"I'll give you a chance... I hope you won't disappoint me."

"Guan Niang, let's go back together."
Qiao'er from the same village smiled and said to Ye Guanjun beside him.
Ye Wanjun nodded,
"Okay, Qiao'er, let's go back earlier, it will be safer."
Sanli Town is ten miles away from Hexi County. With their walking distance, it can take at least an hour.
In today's world, there are thieves even in broad daylight, let alone at night.
"Guan Niang, are you leaving?"
A man in a long robe, with his hair tied and wearing a crown at the same table quickly stood up.
"Mr. Chai, it's dark and the roads are slippery. Now that I'm done with my work, it's time for me to go back."
Ye Wanjun looked at the man calmly.
This man's name is Chai Zonghan, and he is the young master of the family who set up the banquet.
Chai Zonghan showed reluctance on his face, and his eyes swept across Ye Guanjun's chest without leaving any trace, with a hint of greed in his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 13 The two of them lie down and Guan Niang is in danger. Chapter 14 The husband and wife are harming each other and the evil man comes to visit.
